### Summary by Culture Medium

| Culture Medium | Mean Doubling Time (h) | Number of Runs | Contributing Experiments |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Minimal glucose** | 2.90 | 4 | [EXP-015](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=162) (1.68 h), [EXP-026](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=64) (4.27 h), [EXP-032](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=170) (1.90 h), [EXP-034](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=89) (3.76 h) |

| **YPD** | 3.43 | 3 | [EXP-016](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=121) (4.35 h), [EXP-025](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=105) (2.04 h), [EXP-042](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=113) (3.89 h) |
| **Sucrose broth** | 3.90 | 5 | [EXP-033](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=129) (4.92 h), [EXP-035](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=48) (3.66 h), [EXP-041](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=154) (3.40 h), [EXP-044](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=32) (2.59 h), [EXP-052](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=56) (4.94 h) |

### Calculation Formulas
- Minimal glucose mean: `(1.68 + 4.27 + 1.9 + 3.76) / 4 = 2.9025`
- Molasses medium mean: `(2.76 + 3.85 + 1.89 + 4.05 + 2.71) / 5 = 3.052`
- YPD mean: `(4.349 + 2.04 + 3.89) / 3 = 3.426`
- Sucrose broth mean: `(4.921 + 3.66 + 3.4 + 2.59 + 4.94) / 5 = 3.902`
